## ✅ Checklist

### Issue discussion declaration

<!--- This declaration is required. Do not remove or change its wording. -->

Discuss changes before implementing them to confirm that the problem and proposed approach fit the project. See [Discuss before implementing](https://github.com/tossnet/Blazor-Calendar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#discuss-before-implementing) for the process and exceptions.

- [ ] I have discussed this change in an issue and received maintainer agreement before implementation, or a documented exception applies.

### AI contribution declaration

<!--- Both declarations are required whether or not AI tools were used. Do not remove or change their wording. -->

AI assistance is allowed; fully AI-generated or autonomous pull requests without meaningful human review are not accepted. See the [AI contribution policy](https://github.com/tossnet/Blazor-Calendar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-contribution-policy).

- [ ] I have read and followed the AI contribution policy.
- [ ] I have personally reviewed and understood all changes, tested them, and take responsibility for this contribution.
